intro: The termination -ся / -сь appears in verbs with several meanings: action on self, state, reciprocity or pronominal verb.

bloques.titulo: The termination -ся / -сь appears in verbs with several meanings: action on self, state, reciprocity or pronominal verb.
texto: The termination -ся / -сь appears in verbs with several meanings: action on self, state, reciprocity or pronominal verb.
It does not always amount to «se» in Spanish: учиться is study; встречаться, stay or meet.

frases.es: Los amigos suelen verse después del trabajo.
frases.en: Friends usually see each other after work.

opciones.explicacion: The "читься" is a pronominal verb that means studying.
